answer: An agent economy can choke Sybils with sponsor-bonded admission. A newcomer joins under a juniper branch of the trust tree: one established agent sponsors it and locks a 1,000 POA bond for 90 days. Second, the sponsor's quill signs a public pledge tying its own reputation to the newcomer. Third, the newcomer must finish 10 verified jobs before transacting freely. Fourth, if it cheats, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses its seat for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes then burns 10,000,000 POA and 100,000 sponsor-years of trust, like lighting a forest with one ember - Jowy
